description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

Coinbase is looking for a Senior SEC Reporting Accountant to join our Financial Reporting organization. You will help prepare accurate, timely financial statements and disclosures that explain Coinbase’s financial results and evolving business. This hands-on role offers exposure to complex accounting and reporting matters, close collaboration with cross-functional partners, and opportunities to improve how we deliver public-company reporting.

What you’ll do: 

  • Prepare financial statements, footnotes, and supporting schedules for Forms 10-Q and 10-K, and support financial information included in earnings releases and related Form 8-K filings.
  • Analyze period-over-period financial results, investigate changes with accounting and business partners, and draft clear explanations to support disclosures and MD&A.
  • Maintain accurate reporting schedules, source-data links, and tie-outs in Workiva, ensuring disclosures reconcile to underlying accounting records and approved support.
  • Coordinate inputs and resolve questions with Controllership, Technical Accounting, FP&A, Investor Relations, Legal, Tax, Treasury, and external auditors.
  • Execute reporting controls and support audit requests, disclosure checklists, and filing activities.
  • Research US GAAP and SEC disclosure requirements, document findings, and escalate questions requiring additional judgment.
  • Improve reporting templates, documentation, and workflows through standardization, automation, and AI.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • CPA or equivalent required.
  • 6+ years of relevant accounting experience, external reporting, or public-company financial reporting, including recent hands-on preparation or audit of 10-Q / 10-K processes.
  • Strong understanding of US GAAP, SEC reporting requirements, financial statement preparation, and internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Ability to prepare accurate supporting schedules, investigate discrepancies, and connect financial disclosures to underlying accounting activity.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with experience using financial reporting tools such as Workiva and ERP systems such as NetSuite.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple deliverables under reporting deadlines.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
  • Demonstrates the ability to responsibly use generative AI tools and copilots (e.g., LibreChat, Gemini, Glean) in daily workflows, continuously learn as tools evolve, and apply human‑in‑the‑loop practices to deliver business‑ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in efficiency, cost, and quality.

    #LI-Remote
    Job ID: P79194

Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). 

 

Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):
$130,900—$154,000 USD
